name: Triangle Pose
hero_alt: Triangle Pose, seen from the side
meta_description: Front knee bending, torso collapsing, top arm drifting, chest facing the floor? Three things usually hold back Triangle Pose, and a daily exercise for each.
og_description: Three things usually hold back Triangle Pose, and a daily exercise that fixes each one.
lede: Both legs straight, torso long over the front leg, top arm reaching straight up, chest open. Here’s the rubric Posewise measures it against, and what to train when you miss.
rubric_intro: Posewise checks five things from the side. Here’s what good looks like.

rubric.name: Torso
rubric.good: Long over the front leg, hinged from the hip

rubric.name: Top arm
rubric.good: Straight up, stacked over your shoulder

rubric.name: Chest
rubric.good: Turned open, not facing the floor

fixes.outcome: both legs will stay straight as you hinge.
fixes.why: Tight hamstrings stop the hinge at the hip, so the front knee bends or the torso folds down instead. Until they ease, bring your bottom hand higher up your shin.
fixes.cue: Straighten your front leg and hinge from your hip.

fixes.outcome: your top arm will reach straight up.
fixes.why: When shoulder range runs out, the top arm drifts off vertical instead of stacking over the shoulder.
fixes.cue: Reach your top arm straight up, stacked over your shoulder.

fixes.outcome: your chest will open toward the ceiling.
fixes.why: A chest that stays facing the floor usually points to a stiff upper back that won’t rotate.
fixes.cue: Roll your top shoulder back and open your chest.

cues: And one cue: reach all the way out through your top fingertips.

faq.q: Should my hand touch the floor in Triangle Pose?
faq.a: No. Rest it on your shin, ankle or a block, wherever your torso stays long and your chest stays open.

faq.q: Should my front knee be bent in Triangle Pose?
faq.a: No, both legs stay straight. Keep a micro-bend in the front knee so you don’t lock it, and shorten your stance if your hamstrings won’t allow it.

faq.q: Why do I fall forward in Triangle Pose?
faq.a: Usually reaching too far down. Bring your bottom hand higher, reach your top arm up, and roll your top shoulder back.

faq.q: Where should I look in Triangle Pose?
faq.a: Up at your top hand if your neck is comfortable. Otherwise look straight ahead or down at your front foot.

faq.q: How can I check my Triangle Pose form at home?
faq.a: Film yourself from the side. Or use Posewise, an iPhone app that measures your Triangle Pose with the camera, speaks corrections as you hold it, and builds a six-minute daily plan for what it finds.

llms_summary: the three things that usually hold back Triangle Pose (tight hamstrings bending the front knee or collapsing the torso, stiff shoulders pulling the top arm off vertical, a stiff upper back keeping the chest facing down), with the alignment rubric and a daily exercise for each.
